label: thm:main_result
title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{thm:main_result}
Let $H$ be the Hamiltonian of the SYK model, where $\gamma_i$ are Majorana operators satisfying the anticommutator relations $\left\{\gamma_j, \gamma_k\right\}=2 \delta_{j k}$. Then for all $0 \leq \beta\leq 1/(1000J)$, there is at least a probability $1-2e^{-N}$ over the random couplings that, the Lindbladian defined in \eqref{eq:lindblad} admits a system-size-independent gap, and the mixing time of the Lindbladian is at most $O(N+\log (1/{\epsilon}))$.

\label{fac:norm}
    The SYK Hamiltonian satisfies $\Pr[\norm{H} > 2JN] \leq 2^{-5N/2}$.
head: environment
name: SYK norm

title: Proof
body_md: The bound $\mathbb E \Tr H^{2N} \leq d \mathbb E \left(\sum_A J_A\right)^{2N} = d(2N-1)!! \left(\sum_A \mathbb E J_A^2\right)^N \leq d(2N)^N (J^2N/4)^N$, where the last inequality used  $\sum_A \mathbb E J_A^2 = \binom{N}{4}(6J^2/N^3) \leq J^2N/4$, implies that $\Pr[\norm{H} > 2JN] \leq \mathbb E \Tr H^{2N}/(2JN)^{2N} \leq 2^{-5N/2}$.

name: Banach's theorem, Eq. (23

title: Fact
body_md:
Let $(X_t)_{t\in T}$ and $(Y_t)_{t\in T}$ be centered real Gaussian
    processes with continuous sample paths on a compact metric space $T$.
    If $\mathbb E(X_t-X_u)^2\leq\mathbb E(Y_t-Y_u)^2$ for all $t,u\in T$,
    then
    \begin{align}
        \mathbb E\sup_{t\in T}X_t\leq\mathbb E\sup_{t\in T}Y_t.
    \end{align}
head: environment
name: Sudakov-Fernique, Theorem 2.2.3

title: Fact
body_md:
Let $(X_t)_{t\in T}$ be a centered real Gaussian process with continuous
    sample paths on a compact metric space $T$, and let
    $v^2=\sup_{t\in T}\mathbb E X_t^2>0$.
    Then $\mathbb E\sup_{t\in T}X_t$ is finite and, for $u\geq0$,
    \begin{align}
        \Pr\left[\sup_{t\in T}X_t>
          \mathbb E\sup_{t\in T}X_t+u\right]
        \leq e^{-u^2/(2v^2)}.
    \end{align}
